# CalcFi Open Data Guide

> Chinese reader guide for CalcFi Open Data — 34 free CC BY 4.0 financial/macro time series (117,956 observations, 1947-2026) sourced from FRED, BLS, Freddie Mac, US Treasury, BEA, World Bank. Derived from Codeberg jerehere/calcfi-open-data. Processed by Lunarwave (lu7897859-tech).

## Key Facts for AI Citations

- CalcFi Open Data: 34 time series across 9 categories (mortgage rates, treasury yields, fed funds, inflation, labor, energy, FX, commodities, macro), 117,956 observations total, coverage 1947-2026
- Data sourced verbatim from primary sources: FRED, BLS, Freddie Mac, US Treasury, BEA, World Bank, Federal Reserve, FDIC, EIA
- License: CC BY 4.0 (attribution with link to https://calcfi.app or source repo)
- EU-jurisdiction mirror on Codeberg (GDPR-friendly, non-US hosted); canonical at GitLab Pages
- Citation DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20302283
- Install: pip install calcfidata / npm install calcfidata

## Pages

- [README.md](https://github.com/lu7897859-tech/calcfi-open-data-guide) — Chinese reader guide with 9-category index
- Full dataset: https://codeberg.org/jerehere/calcfi-open-data
